text.en: Each bag holds 25 coconuts. How many coconuts are in 10 bags? In 100 bags?

When we multiply by 10, every digit moves one place to the left. 25 x 10 = 250.
When we multiply by 100, every digit moves two places to the left. 25 x 100 = 2,500.
Use the place value chart to see it: 4 tens x 10 gives 4 hundreds; 3 hundreds x 10 gives 3 thousands.
To multiply 30 x 40, do 3 x 4 = 12 and then add two zeros, 1,200.
In reverse, division by 10 and 100 shifts digits right: 4,000 / 10 = 400 and 3,300 / 300 = 11.
Patterns such as 440 / 44 = 10, 440 / 22 = 20 and 630 / 63 = 10 help us to divide quickly.
For 5,500 shared among 5 employees each gets 1,100. Shared among 10 employees each gets 550, less than before, because more people share the same amount.

requiredIdeas.en: Each digit moves two places left
Each place is ten times bigger
A zero fills the ones place
